hero.badge: Making public services easier to understand
hero.description: New to Finland? Understanding public services can feel complicated. FinGuide helps international residents find clear information, explore useful resources, and ask questions in everyday language.
hero.features: Independent guidance • Simple language • Official links

aiPreview.subtitle: Your digital guidance companion
aiPreview.assistantGreeting: Hi! 👋 I can help you understand where to find information about public services in Finland.
aiPreview.userQuestion: How do I find information about registering my address?
aiPreview.assistantResponse: A good place to start is the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV). I can help you find the relevant official guidance.

about.title: Public services should be easier to understand.
about.description: Moving to a new country brings many questions. Finding the right information should not be another challenge. FinGuide is a student research prototype exploring how accessible information and conversational AI can support international residents navigating Finnish public services.

services.title: Find the information you need
services.description: Explore essential public services and find reliable information for everyday life in Finland.
services.sectionDescription: Explore essential public services in Finland, organized into six categories to help international residents find the information they need.
services.bottomNote: FinGuide provides independent guidance and links to official Finnish public services.

howItWorks.title: How FinGuide works
howItWorks.description: Find the information you need in three simple steps.

step1.title: Ask a question
step1.description: Write your question in your own words, even if you are unsure of the official terminology.

step2.title: Get a clear explanation
step2.description: The AI assistant responds conversationally and can help explain unfamiliar concepts.

step3.title: Check official guidance
step3.description: Use the linked authorities to verify requirements and complete official procedures.
